item.title: النائب العام التمييزي كلّف القوى الأمنية بمعاينة محطات المحروقات والتثبت مما إذا كان بعضها مقفلًا أو
item.description:
النائب العام التمييزي كلّف القوى الأمنية بمعاينة محطات المحروقات والتثبت مما إذا كان بعضها مقفلًا أو إذا كان البعض الآخر يقنّن في تسليم المحروقات للمواطنين والسيارات، وتنظيم محاضر ضبط بحق المحطات المخالفة.
كما كلّف شعبة المعلومات بمعاينة الشركات المستوردة للمحروقات والتثبت مما إذا كانت تسلّم المحروقات بصورة منتظمة إلى المحطات، وفي حال ثبوت مخالفة أي منها، تنظيم محاضر بحقها تمهيدًا للشروع بملاحقتها قضائيًا.
──────────────
Lebanon’s Prosecutor General at the Court of Cassation tasked security forces with inspecting fuel stations to determine whether some are closed or whether others are restricting fuel distribution to citizens and vehicles, and to issue violation reports against non-compliant stations.
He also tasked the Information Branch with inspecting fuel-importing companies to verify whether they are regularly supplying fuel to stations. If any violations are confirmed, reports will be filed against them in preparation for initiating legal proceedings.
──────────────

item.title: 🚨 Iraqi government statement: -We condemn and denounce the attack carried out by U.S. and Saudi forc
item.description:
🚨
Iraqi government statement:
-We condemn and denounce the attack carried out by U.S. and Saudi forces this morning.
-Today's attack came at a time when the government is verifying reports regarding the targeting of Saudi territory.
-The National Security Council decided to develop a comprehensive security plan to address any violation of Iraq's sovereignty and prevent any party from acting as a source of threats to neighboring countries.
-The Foreign Ministry has been instructed to act in accordance with international law to document the situation and uphold Iraq's rights.
-We reaffirm our rejection of all hostile actions, regardless of the party responsible for carrying them out or the justifications presented.
-Dealing with and confronting these attacks is the exclusive responsibility of the Iraqi government and the country's constitutional institutions, and no others.
